verse.verse_1: When the sun Kuwwirat (wound round and lost its light and is overthrown).
verse.verse_2: And when the stars shall fall;
verse.verse_3: And when the mountains shall made to pass away;
verse.verse_4: And when the pregnant she-camels shall be neglected;
verse.verse_5: And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together;
verse.verse_6: And when the seas shall become as blazing Fire or shall overflow;
verse.verse_7: And when the souls shall be joined with their bodies;
verse.verse_8: And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) shall be questioned.
verse.verse_9: For what sin she was killed?
verse.verse_10: And when the written pages of deeds (good and bad) of every person shall be laid open;
verse.verse_11: And when the heaven shall be stripped off and taken away from its place;
verse.verse_12: And when Hell-fire shall be kindled to fierce ablaze.
verse.verse_13: And when Paradise shall be brought near,
verse.verse_14: (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil).
verse.verse_15: So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night).
verse.verse_16: And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves,
verse.verse_17: And by the night as it departs;
verse.verse_18: And by the dawn as it brightens;
verse.verse_19: Verily, this is the Word (this Quran brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrael (Gabriel), from Allah to the Prophet Muhammad (Peace be upon him)].
verse.verse_20: Owner of power, and high rank with (Allah) the Lord of the Throne,
verse.verse_21: Obeyed (by the angels), trustworthy there (in the heavens).
verse.verse_22: And (O people) your companion (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) is not a madman;
verse.verse_23: And indeed he (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) saw him [Jibrael (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east).
verse.verse_24: And he (Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) withholds not a knowledge of the unseen.
verse.verse_25: And it (the Quran) is not the word of the outcast Shaitan (Satan).
verse.verse_27: Verily, this (the Quran) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns).
verse.verse_28: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight,
verse.verse_29: And you will not, unless (it be) that Allah wills, the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
